title: ICE Agent Shoots Man During Arrest Attempt in New York Neighborhood
summary: The man was in a car with a 5-year-old in the back seat when he was shot and wounded, the authorities said. Mayor Zohran Mamdani said the Trump administration was “terrorizing our city.”
